headline: Guidance rises as growth accelerates and profits rebound
summary_short: Total revenue rose 16% year-over-year to $1.208 billion, led by Xywav, Epidiolex and Zepzelca growth plus the newly-launched Modeyso, while GAAP net income swung to $192.8 million from a $718.5 million loss a year ago. Jazz raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $4.60-$4.75 billion from $4.25-$4.50 billion.
summary_long: Revenue grew 16% y/y to $1.208B, led by Xywav (+13% to $471M), Epidiolex/Epidyolex (+16% to $292M), Zepzelca (+42% to $106M) and newly-launched Modeyso ($48M). GAAP operating income of $248.2M swung from a $686.4M loss a year ago, when a $905.4M Chimerix IPR&D charge weighed; 2Q26 carried a much smaller $77.0M IPR&D charge for the AbCellera collaboration and Werewolf asset purchase. Net income was $192.8M (diluted EPS $2.78) versus a $718.5M loss. Cash fell 12% q/q to $1.620B after repaying $1.0B of exchangeable notes in June; total debt principal fell 19% q/q to $4.351B. Full-year revenue guidance raised to $4.60-$4.75B from $4.25-$4.50B, with SG&A, R&D and diluted-share-count guidance also raised.
